name: Independent Service Providers
summary: ISP formed July 2001 from the A2U (ATU) + Viper merger at isp.net.au; ABN cancelled 2007, brand continued under successor entities.

events.details: Formed from the A2U + Viper merger (brand 'ISP').
ABN cancelled 20 Dec 2007; brand continued as 'Information Service Providers' under successor entities.
